en.title: Balloon Color Pairs
en.description:
Positions are initially uncolored; each query colors a position with a given color (overwriting is allowed). After each query, count the pairs of adjacent positions that are both colored and have the same color.

The semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked as "this site's addition" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided them.
en.input: length,q≤200000, followed by q lines of a 0-based index and a positive color value.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness and complexity.
